description: This source file contains unit tests for the class SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper, focusing on reprocessing loan repayment schedules with different charge scenarios. It uses mocking frameworks to simulate dependencies and verifies the calculation and distribution of charge portions within loan repayment periods.

classes.name: SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapperTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the behavior of SingleLoanChargeRepaymentScheduleProcessingWrapper, particularly how it handles different charge types during schedule reprocessing.

methods.name: testOnePeriodWithFeeCharge
methods.description: Tests reprocessing a schedule with a fee charge applied during a single period.

methods.name: testOnePeriodWithPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Tests reprocessing a schedule with a penalty charge during a single period.

methods.name: testTwoPeriodsWithPenaltyCharge
methods.description: Tests reprocessing a schedule split into two periods with penalty charges.

methods.name: customVerify
methods.description: Verifies that the charge portions added to the installment match expected values.

methods.name: createCharge
methods.description: Creates and mocks a Charge object to simulate different charge scenarios for testing.

methods.name: createPeriod
methods.description: Creates a mock LoanRepaymentScheduleInstallment with specified dates and amounts.
